vision.name: Saiyan Defiant Mastery
vision.text:
[Continuous]: Your attacks deal +1 life card.
[Defense] POWER: Prevent all damage from an attack if you have 1 or less cards in your hand. Raise or lower a player's anger 1.
POWER: Discard 2 cards from your hand to search your Life Deck for a Styled [Warning] card and place it into your hand.
vision.note: portrait Mastery layout; title strip read from a crop; DR number printed; black warning triangle transcribed as [Warning]
